Built-In Smart Bottom Freezer Refrigerator

  • Enhance your kitchen experience with a 36" premium refrigerator, built right into your cabinetry for a completely custom finish

20.2 Cu. Ft. Capacity

Additional Features

  • Adjustable Glass Shelves
  • Sabbath Mode
  • ConnectPlus

product.description:
Features:

  • 20.2 cu. Ft. capacity and layout meet the needs of today's homes
  • LED lighting illuminates interior for better viewing of contents
  • Convertible drawer with 4 temperature settings including cold drinks, meat, snacks, or frozen items
  • Equipped with ice maker and divider slide
  • Featuring 3 half-width adjustable fresh food door bins
  • Adjustable shelves allow for storage customization to fit your every day needs
  • Match your appliance to your kitchen's aesthetic with customized hardware options
  • Covered under 1 year limited parts and labor and 5 year limited sealed system parts and labor manufacturer warranties

Product Technology:

  • ConnectPlus Wi-Fi: connect with a smart device to display/change temperature, alert if fresh food temperature is too high, alert if freezer temperature is too high, alert if water filter needs to be replaced, and alert for software updates

Specifications:

  • Refrigerator Capacity: 13.8 Cu. Ft.
  • Freezer Capacity: 3.5 Cu. Ft.
  • Total Capacity: 20.2 Cu. Ft.
  • Bulb Type: LED
  • Shelf Material (Refrigerator): Glass
  • Counter Depth: No
  • Crisper Bins: Yes
  • Depth: 24-3/4"
  • Height: 83-1/2"
  • Width: 35-3/4"
  • Amperage: 20A
  • Voltage: 115V
